definition.def: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.
examples: He was given the task of protecting her for the duration of the trial.

definition.def: If you say that something will happen for the duration, you mean that it will happen for as long as a particular situation continues.
examples: His wounds knocked him out of combat for the duration.
